The description: public officials who, in the performance of duties, accept bribes, collude, etc., causing loss. The facts: He accepted a call, gave favor, processed fraudulent documents. He may have accepted bribes? Not mentioned. He just facilitated. The public prosecutor says his behavior constitutes "××". We need to infer the label used in dataset.
